items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: The Sonny South band, Alvin Alcon and quite a few fellas was playing with them.

ctx.x: Where was that and what was that?
I don't know. The Sonny South band, Alvin Alcon and quite a few fellas was playing with them.
Oh yeah, I forgot the name.
